story_text:
As a user, I want to reset my password via email so that I can regain access to my account.

AC1: Request reset with email
AC2: Receive reset link within 5 minutes
AC3: Link expires after 1 hour
AC4: New password must meet complexity rules
AC5: Old sessions invalidated after reset
AC6: Rate limit: 3 requests per hour
architecture_text: Auth module: src/auth/. Password reset via email token (JWT, 1h expiry). Rate limiting with Redis. Session invalidation via token blacklist.

story_text:
As a user, I want to upload files to my project so that I can share documents with my team.

AC1: Support PDF, PNG, JPG, DOCX (max 50MB)
AC2: Virus scan before storage
AC3: Generate thumbnails for images
AC4: Progress bar during upload
AC5: Retry on network failure (3 attempts)
AC6: Deduplication by content hash
architecture_text: Multipart upload to S3. ClamAV for virus scanning. Sharp for image thumbnails. Presigned URLs for direct upload. Content-addressable storage for dedup.

story_text:
As a customer, I want to pay for my order using credit card or PayPal so that I can complete my purchase.

AC1: Support Visa, Mastercard, Amex
AC2: PayPal redirect flow
AC3: 3D Secure for cards > €100
AC4: Payment failure shows clear error
AC5: Retry up to 3 times
AC6: Order status updates within 5 seconds
architecture_text: Payment module: src/payment/ with Stripe SDK for cards, PayPal REST API for PayPal. Webhook handler for async confirmations. Redis for idempotency keys.
